## BRAVE — Vanilla+ Optimization Pack
BRAVE is a lightweight Minecraft 1.21.11 modpack focused on performance, vanilla-style visuals and useful client improvements. It uses modern optimization mods such as [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix-mvus/versions) and other performance improvements to make the game smoother and more stable.
The pack keeps the original Minecraft experience, while making the game smoother, cleaner and more immersive. It also includes several fixes for vanilla bugs and inconsistencies. Only carefully selected mods are included — no unnecessary gameplay changes.

## 🦆 Performance
BRAVE includes modern optimization improvements that enhance:
- FPS and overall smoothness
- RAM usage
- rendering and game logic
- entity and block culling
- GUI performance

This helps Minecraft run much better even on weaker PCs.

## 🍀 Vanilla+ Visuals
Visual improvements that stay true to the vanilla style:
- shader support
- connected textures
- improved entity textures and models
- smoother biome color blending
- small particle and visual polish
- improved player animations

## 🧩 QoL
Helpful client-side features:
- food saturation display
- shulker box previews
- better inventory controls
- improved tooltips
- dynamic crosshair
- world map
- Plasmo Voice
- Emotecraft

## 🧽 Compatibility
BRAVE is client-side friendly and can be used on almost any server.

It also includes [ViaFabricPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabricplus), allowing you to connect to many older Minecraft versions without switching installations.

## 🤔 Updates?

The modpack is actively maintained and will receive:
updates for new Minecraft versions
possible support for older versions
